resource.name: Building Permits-Chicago
resource.description:
Update (October 15, 2025): A new field, PERMIT_CONDITION, is now part of this release.

The records span Chicago building permits from 2006 onward. Rows cover permits that remained valid after issue; those later voided or revoked are omitted. Permit categories generally require payment of the fee before construction may start—no work should proceed until fees are satisfied.
columns_description: Current status of permit (not available for all permit types).
Amount of building permit fees received
Amount of building permit fees due
Total amount of the building permit fee, which includes both paid and unpaid fees.
Date when the building permit was issued, which can indicate the timeline of the project and its current status.
Category of the building permit, which can provide context on the type of construction and expected duration.
Estimated number of days the permit is valid for, which can help predict if the permit is still active.
Date when the building permit application was submitted, indicating the initial timeline of the project.
Specific type of building permit, which can provide more detailed context about the nature of the construction.
Date when the building permit expires, which can help predict if the permit is still valid.
Condition of the building permit as noted by the issuing authority, providing direct insight into the current status.
Status of any renewal requests for the building permit, indicating if the permit has been extended or not.
Source of the building permit application, which can indicate the type of project and its priority.
Number of times the building permit application has been made, indicating the frequency and persistence of the project.
Ratio of the building permit fees that have been paid to the total fees, indicating financial progress on the project.
Date when the last update was made to the building permit record, indicating recent activity or inactivity.
Estimated duration of the building project in months, based on historical data and permit conditions.
